rows.officialClass: SIC 2007 group 561: Restaurants and mobile food service activities
rows.measure: enterprise births in 2019 divided by active enterprises in 2019, percent
rows.note: Group 561 holds licensed restaurants (56.10/1), unlicensed restaurants and cafes (56.10/2), takeaways and mobile food together; the subclasses are not published. Derived from the release's own counts: 18,105 enterprise births of 107,035 active enterprises (both control rounded to base 5; Tables 1.2 and 3.2).
